limitations: Research comparison output, not a treatment recommendation or demonstrated sleep improvement.
Validation and Test were previously exposed and reused; this is not fresh external confirmation.
The fixed Two-Process constants are an engineering model, not measured personal physiology.
Wearable-derived timing can be affected by wear, device, and scoring behavior.
CMI and MESA are separate reference cohorts; their predictions are not a validated combined ensemble.
Population and device generalization require prospective validation after SleepWell enrollment.

prior.method: equal-participant mean from Train nights only

research_metrics.processing: Train-only predictor 1/99 percentile clipping + constant removal + standard scaling in every fold; no target clipping/removal; equal participant fit weights
research_metrics.selection: Train inner-CV selects candidate per data/hybrid arm, then one-SE simplicity rule selects final arm including baselines; Validation does not select
research_metrics.test_status: adaptive analysis of reused Validation and Test; never claim fresh external confirmation; no Validation/Test tuning in this run

target: next main-sleep onset and final wake offsets in minutes after the local 20:00 cutoff
